prompt: Create an original bright Japanese fantasy tactical RPG terrain texture atlas. One horizontal 3:1 image divided into exactly three equal square panels, edge-to-edge with no frames or gaps. NO text, symbols, grids, borders, perspective, buildings, trees, large rocks, props, units or UI. Straight overhead flat texture only, designed for tiling under small tactical units. Broad clean hand-painted gouache/cel-like color masses, softly textured, very low contrast, controlled sparse detail, no photorealism or rough oil impasto. Left square: fresh sage and lime green meadow ground, tiny scattered soft grass clusters and faint ochre earth showing through, mostly calm green, seamless grass at edges. Center square: pale warm ochre sandy earth, soft tiny mineral flecks and patches of dry grass, mostly calm sand, seamless edges. Right square: clear turquoise river surface with broad soft blue-green currents and a few gentle pale ripples, no shore or objects, seamless water edges. Consistent gentle upper-left sunlight, muted enough to keep units and range overlays readable at small scale. Important texture stays very subtle, do not paint a scenic landscape.

Create an ORIGINAL game-ready sprite atlas of SIX fantasy tactical RPG troops, with transparent alpha background. Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, each equally sized square cell contains one distinct full-body character centered with generous transparent margin. No overlap across cells, no text, borders, grid, UI, logos or floor plates. All six stand in a compact ready battle pose, viewed from a high three-quarter front camera, facing slightly left, whole head, feet, weapons and silhouette visible. Bright polished Japanese tactical RPG / anime strategy game art, charming three-head-tall chibi proportions, expressive adult faces, large simple readable color shapes, crisp silhouette, soft painted/cel-shaded volumes, restrained fine detail, consistent warm upper-left light and teal ambient shadows. Antique gold, teal cloth, silver armor, dark indigo accents. Original designs only, no existing game characters. Top left: sturdy adult male swordsman with dark short hair, silver breastplate, teal tabard, broad sword and small kite shield. Top middle: stout adult male heavy spearman in silver helmet, antique gold trim and teal cape, long spear upright and tall shield. Top right: adult female auburn-haired cavalry lancer with teal cape riding a compact gray horse, full horse and lance fit within the square, clear horse silhouette. Bottom left: adult androgynous elf archer with pointed ears, pale blond hair, forest green cloak and wooden bow. Bottom middle: adult male black-haired fire mage in red and indigo robes, holding a small orange flame and a staff. Bottom right: adult female dark-haired healer wearing ivory and sage green robes, gentle gold healing crystal on a wooden staff. Dark contact shadows directly under feet, otherwise empty transparent background. Must read as six distinct battlefield sprites at 50 pixels tall, not portraits or trading cards.
